_about: Strings that must not appear in user-visible copy (source string literals and rendered text) of the Knack dashboard and desktop renderers. Matching is case-insensitive on whole words. The allow-list at the bottom is the only place the old name may remain: internal identifiers, env names, file names, storage keys. See docs/KNACK_UX.md section 5 and rule 6.
visible_words_note: Whole word, any case, in visible text and aria text. The owner removed the word demo from every visible string (docs/KNACK_UX.md), and on 8 Nov 2026 (D57) the words synthetic and simulated too: a screen says concretely where numbers come from (generators we wrote, planted example learners, language-model participants, example people made for this build) and carries no synthetic tag. Data enums and identifiers (origin: synthetic) are not copy and stay. apps/dashboard/scripts/check-words.mjs checks the same words on the rendered page and stays in the build.

visible_old_name.scope: text nodes, aria-label, alt, placeholder, document.title, window and notification titles, tray labels

jargon_note: Allowed inside Details, in Evidence and on Admin screens where the term is the established name; never in a worker's default view.
mono_capitals: text-transform: uppercase is allowed only on chart axes and the work ribbon (.t-label--mono, .svg-text)
